'''Merya''' is a [[Saldaean]] woman with whom [[Elyas Machera]] had a tempestuous relationship for a year. 

==History==
Elyas tells [[Perrin Aybara]] in an attempt to teach him about Saldaean woman in general and Perrin's [[Faile Bashere|wife]] in particular. Elyas said the Merya shouted at him and even threw dishes at him. In the end, she left him because he was too "restrained" for her tastes.{{ref/book|8|10}}
